_doc: Crew posts of the prison base (scripts/prison/prison_posts.gd). A person on a post stands at `pos` (tiles) and shoots only the dead in the field of fire: within `range` tiles and within `arc` degrees either side of `face` (degrees, 0 = east, 90 = south). `cover` (0..1) shrinks the reach of a bite on them. `exposed` posts can break a coward. `fit`: trait id -> aim multiplier at this post. Towers stay as they were; a person with no post is a tower guard.

posts.blurb: Behind the gate pillars. Covers the gate and the south wire.
